desc: Derive feasibility condition: need S >= M with f(S) = sum_a min(cntA[a], cntB[S-a]) >= L, where L = max(0, fixedA + fixedB - N).
Implement the complete Python solution using the provided packed-key sort code with shortcuts for L <= 1, all-fixed, and one-side-all-fixed cases.
Verify the solution on samples and edge cases such as all -1, one side all -1, duplicates, all fixed, and large values.
